_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: STP marketing strategy for products, services, programs, brands, and go-to-market plans: define the relevant market;…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "Use STP marketing to choose which customer segment this product should focus on and how to position it."
cases.context: The agent has access to the stp-marketing skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is stp-marketing the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes stp-marketing as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against positioning, pestel, porters-five-forces
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the stp-marketing workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore stp-marketing
Does not route to positioning, pestel, porters-five-forces when the stp-marketing scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
